'''R5-L26''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
R5-L26 was present during [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|assault]] on [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia's]] [[Adi Gallia's flagship/Legends|flagship]]. While the crew was evacuating, R5-L26 was running around, but then bumped into [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] who was escaping along with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] aboard a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]].<ref name="ND">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Despite R5-L26 being confirmed as an R5 unit,<ref name="BR2D2" /> the droid's frame is actually an [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4-series]], which establishes a continuity error.
